description: This file defines the BubbleNode class, a custom lexical node extending DecoratorBlockNode that represents an interactive 'bubble' element in a rich text editor. It includes methods for JSON serialization/deserialization, DOM conversion, and rendering via React component.

classes.name: BubbleNode
classes.description: A custom Lexical Node for representing bubble items in the editor. Supports JSON serialization, DOM import/export, and React rendering.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the string 'snbubble' as the node type.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a duplicate of the node with the same id, format, and key.

methods.name: importJSON
methods.description: Creates a BubbleNode instance from serialized JSON data.

methods.name: exportJSON
methods.description: Serializes the node to JSON including its item UUID, format, and type.

methods.name: importDOM
methods.description: Returns DOM conversion rules for importing a div element with the specific data attribute.

methods.name: createDOM
methods.description: Creates a span element representing this node.

methods.name: exportDOM
methods.description: Exports the node as a span element with a data attribute and text content.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a BubbleNode with a unique id, optional format, and key.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the bubble node.

methods.name: getTextContent
methods.description: Returns the text content for the node, formatted with the item id.

methods.name: decorate
methods.description: Returns a React component (BubbleComponent) to render the node.
